recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reopen the old outcome element name for FHIR-11116; any future review of performedActivity naming, binding, or progress/status wording should use the later CarePlan trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-11116 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking for CarePlan.activity.outcome to be better defined and harmonized with Goal.outcome, including a distinction between activity outcomes such as calories consumed and goal outcomes such as measured body weight.
initial_application: Git commit a2b1e7d44e7145eb803af9456a638890b5258d20 explicitly mentions #11116 and applied the historical CarePlan.activity.outcome/result[x] and Goal.outcome wording changes. Later companion commits handled bindings and flattening but were separate issue decisions.
additional_context: The current build no longer has a literal CarePlan.activity.outcome element. FHIR-26064 renamed it to CarePlan.activity.performedActivity and updated the definition/comment; source/fhir.ini maps the old outcomeCodeableConcept and outcomeReference names to performedActivity. FHIR-37262 later removed active Goal.outcome, and FHIR-48415 later removed the obsolete performedActivity note about duplicating an activity status.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active CarePlan definition and comment for performedActivity already preserve the seed's activity-vs-goal distinction, and restoring old CarePlan.activity.outcome or active Goal.outcome wording would conflict with later final Jira decisions.
